People born in October are described as having a keen interest in and an eye for form and structure, which can make them good architects, interior decorators, designers, or any profession that combines art and structure. They are also described as success-oriented, charming, and personally powerful individuals. They are at their best when they are in control, their own boss, or working on their own. They can also get along with others and possess necessary "people skills", although they can occasionally show impatience. Despite being restless at heart, they crave stability and security, which is why they work hard at whatever they do.
